Record Class ProcessingRecipe

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.recipe.ProcessingRecipe
Record Components:
inputs - each matcher's amount is consumed
outputs - produced on completion (may be empty: a sink)
duration - base ticks, scaled by machineengine:process_duration
costPerTick - paid every tick, scaled by machineengine:process_cost; the process pauses while it cannot be paid
chanceOutputs - extra outputs, each produced with its chance (rolled when the process starts)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Recipe, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public record ProcessingRecipe(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key key, @NotNull RecipeType<ProcessingRecipe> type, @NotNull List<ResourceMatcher> inputs, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> outputs, long duration, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> costPerTick, @NotNull List<ChanceOutput> chanceOutputs) extends Record implements Recipe
A timed transformation run by the built-in process (ARCHITECTURE.md §13): consume inputs() when starting, pay costPerTick() every tick for duration() ticks, then produce outputs().
